title: Transformer architecture
text: BB8LM is a decoder-only Transformer with learned positional embeddings and a weight-tied language modeling head.

title: Token decoding strategies
text: BB8 implements greedy decoding, temperature sampling, Top-K sampling and Top-P sampling.

title: BB8 v004 training
text: BB8 v004 uses Qwen2.5-0.5B as its base model, Dolly instruction data and LoRA rank 16 with alpha 32.

title: Instruct baseline provenance
text: The Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct baseline is an external pretrained model. This project did not fine-tune that baseline.

title: Local API interface
text: The BB8 local API exposes GET /health, POST /generate and POST /chat. Requests can require an x-api-key header.

title: Experiment version tracking
text: BB8 stores training run records in experiments/model_registry.jsonl. Records include dataset SHA-256 hashes, configuration, runtime and artifact paths.

title: Interactive token lab
text: The local BB8 server provides a chat page at /chat and a token and dataset lab at /lab.

title: Chat diagnostic results
text: In the original 80-case development suite, Qwen Instruct passed 48 of 57 automatic checks and BB8 v004 passed 26 of 57. These are not general accuracy scores.

title: Aditya graduate education
text: The public portfolio lists a Master of Science in Computer Science from Clemson University, completed in 2025.

title: Movie recommendation project
text: The portfolio reports a movie recommender using FunkSVD on over 26 million ratings, with RMSE 0.76. These are portfolio-reported results, not independently verified measurements.

title: Skynet air quality project
text: The portfolio describes Skynet as an AQI forecasting pipeline using NASA TEMPO, OpenAQ, weather and traffic data.

title: Tech-Portfolio application stack
text: The Tech-Portfolio README documents Next.js 16 with React 19 and TypeScript, hosted using AWS Amplify SSR. Its portfolio co-pilot uses retrieval to ground responses.
